name: Sweden
notes: Scope: national (Riksdag, government), European Parliament, regional (21 län) and local (290 kommuner) level. First pass R001 (2026-10-19) covered the Riksdag motion archive only; the regional and local sweep has not started.

polls.question: Whether a billionaire tax is a good proposal (Oxfam Sverige's release gives no exact wording; Realtid's report describes it as a special tax on people with more than SEK 1 billion in wealth)
polls.sample: 1,056 respondents, web interviews in the randomly recruited Sifopanelen, weighted by sex, age, region and party sympathy
